course_name_original: Competências Transversais: Liderança e Gestão de Equipas
course_name_en: Transversal Competences: Leadership and Team Management

learning_outcomes.text: Understand and critically evaluate different approaches, theories, and leadership styles.
Identify cross-cutting aspects of team functioning, as well as their relational dynamics.
Identify and apply communication skills in a teamwork context and recognize their importance for leadership and for the well-being and functioning of teams.
Identify practices of humanized and transformative leadership, recognizing the critical factors associated with them.
Establish plans for introspection and self-evaluation to enhance leadership and team management abilities.

syllabus_topics: Traits, Behavioral, Situational, Transformational, and Servant Leadership
Characteristics and properties of work teams
Conflict: its emerging nature and function
The role of communication in establishing and managing interpersonal relationships
Reciprocity and feedback in the communication process
The challenges associated with the transition to leadership positions
teaching_methods: Analysis and integrative synthesis of learning
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 60% for participation and involvement during classes, and 40% for fieldwork and the written assignment. Attendance at 75% of classes is required.
